name: pcb-designer
description: AI-powered PCB design tool. Requires a Local Agent with KiCad 8 installed. Parses natural-language hardware descriptions, generates a BOM, synthesises a KiCad schematic and board layout via pcbnew, and exports Gerbers. Output changes with every prompt.
author: assalas
local_agent_dependencies: KiCad 8 (https://www.kicad.org/download/) — provides pcbnew Python bindings and kicad-cli

credentials.name: OCTOPART_API_KEY
credentials.description: Optional: Octopart API key for live vendor BOM lookups

tools.name: parse_requirements
tools.description: Extract structured component requirements from a natural-language hardware description using deep LLM reasoning with chain-of-thought analysis.

tools.name: generate_bom
tools.description: Generate a Bill of Materials from structured requirements. Queries Octopart when credentials are available, otherwise uses the built-in component catalog.

tools.name: extract_package_from_pdf
tools.description: Extract package dimensions from a component datasheet PDF. Multi-stage pipeline: text extraction, OCR fallback, LLM-powered dimensional analysis.

tools.name: generate_footprint
tools.description: Generate a KiCad .kicad_mod footprint file. Supports: qfn, qfp, soic, smd_rc, bga, dip, usbc, header, custom.

tools.name: synthesize_netlist
tools.description: Generate a KiCad netlist from a BOM with automatic decoupling capacitors and support circuits.

tools.name: route_pcb
tools.description: Route a PCB board from a netlist using KiCad pcbnew (requires Local Agent with KiCad 8). Uses smart heuristic placement and Manhattan routing.

tools.name: full_pipeline
tools.description: Run the complete end-to-end pipeline from a natural-language description to a downloadable KiCad project ZIP (board, schematic, BOM, Gerbers). Requires a Local Agent with KiCad 8.
